headlines.name: Math115.RationalClockStep.incomingLaw_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (x : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N h : ℕ),
  Math115.RationalClockStep.incomingLaw r c U L hr hc x N h =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw (Math115.RationalClockStep.proposalLawAt r c U L x N) fun proposal =>
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw
        (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.oracleFamily r c U L hr hc h
          ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none)
          ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none) ↑x)
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.completionDecision
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
            ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none))
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L
            (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
            ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none))
          (↑x) proposal)

headlines.name: Math115.RationalClockStep.incomingLaw_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (hp :
    2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
  (x : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N h : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (Math115.RationalClockStep.incomingLaw r c U L hr hc x N h)
      (Math115.RationalClockStep.idealIncomingLaw r c U L hr hc hp x) ≤
    (1 / 2) ^ N + Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h

headlines.name: Math115.RationalClockStep.idealIncomingLaw_mass_ne
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀
      (hp :
        2 ≤
          Fintype.card
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
      (x : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (y : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
      ↑x ≠ y →
        (Math115.RationalClockStep.idealIncomingLaw r c U L hr hc hp x).mass y =
          if
              OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.physicalAdjacent r c U L
                (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L) ⋯ (↑x) y then
            ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.acceptedCount
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L
                    (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
                    ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none))
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L
                    (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
                    ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none))
                  (↑x) y) /
              (↑(Math115.RationalClockProposal.denominator r c U) *
                ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.blockCount
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L
                      (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
                      ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none))
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L
                      (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
                      ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none))
                    ↑x))
          else 0

headlines.name: Math115.RationalClockStep.idealIncomingLaw_mass_ne_cast
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀
      (hp :
        2 ≤
          Fintype.card
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
      (x : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (y : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
      ↑x ≠ y →
        ↑((Math115.RationalClockStep.idealIncomingLaw r c U L hr hc hp x).mass y) =
          Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.referenceConductance r c U L
              ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none)
              ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none) (↑x) y /
            (2 * ↑(Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.defectAllowance r c U) *
              Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.defectWeight r c U L x)
